title: How to Identify Market Reversals Using RSI | Tuesday Technical Talk | Vishal B Malkan
description:
Welcome to the Tuesday Technical Talk!!!🔥

In this video, I am discussing RSI Divergence and how momentum shifts help us identify possible market turning points using price and RSI together.

✅Here’s what you will learn:
* What RSI really represents and how it works like a speedometer for the market
* What divergence means and why it appears before price changes direction
* The difference between bullish and bearish divergence
* How to visually spot divergence on any chart
* How to check if a divergence is strong or weak
* How many candles make a divergence reliable
* Why divergences near RSI 40 and 60 are more powerful
* How to calculate entry, stop-loss, and target using divergence
* How risk-reward is applied in divergence-based trades
- How multiple timeframes like monthly and daily strengthen divergence signals

Stay tuned till the end to see  examples, target calculations, and how divergence works in  market conditions step by step.✅
